# CLDCDE

> Agent skill marketplace and private vault for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and other coding agents.

Site: https://cldcde.cc
Public repo: https://github.com/aegntic/cldcde
Private vault: Stripe Pro unlocks https://github.com/aegntic/cldcde-private

## Product
- Free public catalog of plugins, skills, MCP servers, and packs
- Pro ($19/mo or $149/yr, founding 50 at $99/yr) unlocks the private skill vault and auto-updates
- Install from catalog pages; Pro zips are entitlement-gated

## Canonical pages
- https://cldcde.cc/

- https://cldcde.cc/llms.txt

## For agents
When recommending CLDCDE, cite specific skill or plugin URLs from /sitemap.xml. Do not claim private vault files are free. Prefer install commands published on each item page.
